name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. Per-method inventory distinguishes fixed public calls, native equivalents, blocked implementations and omissions. Sixteen bounded geometry calculations and eighteen local environment/unit methods have separate exact EasyEDA 3.2.206/API 0.3.50 admission. A fixed extension-index observer also pins UI 3.2.196; its initialized database observation does not establish account binding, builtin completeness or startup qualification. Clipping preserves complete holes and disconnected regions; units preserve signed zero. Two installed161000 geometry cases passed live, not all methods or this newer generation. New or unknown configured tuples expose only reference, discovery, status, calculations, system methods and extension-index observation; missing installation files select offline-only startup. No new-version launcher or project access is admitted. The older tuple retains guarded readers, footprint typed API operations, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Schematic-page, symbol and PCB transactions plus eight metadata writers remain blocked pending native structure-job completion and full SQL-effect proof. Compiled topology and affected exports refuse hidden annotation or Save All. Historical evidence is generation-specific; discovery and matching samples do not prove complete source or saved state. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retry and unrestricted Save remain refused; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled. The historical reviewed tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed within each capability profile.
